source.title: The differential geometry of starfish cycles: a 20-year retrospective and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL source https://zbmath.org/5502622 as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL.

The zbMATH web page fetch was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH REST API was used only as resolver metadata. The API identified Zbl 1153.58302, DOI 10.1016/j.na.2005.02.059, author P. L. Antonelli, and the title The differential geometry of starfish cycles: a 20-year retrospective and open problems.

Identifier-specific recovery followed the DOI, which redirects to https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0362546X05002166. The reachable search-indexed ScienceDirect author page labels the exact article as Research article Abstract only, and no full-text PDF or full HTML article body was exposed there.

Bounded exact-work searches were attempted with the exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, the ScienceDirect PII S0362546X05002166, and exact phrases from the abstract such as Finsler filtering and starfish cycles. Candidate results were rejected because they were abstract-only ScienceDirect pages, citation-only pages, reference-list mentions, or different works.
No readable primary PDF or full HTML source artifact for the exact work was recovered, so no document map was constructed.

No candidates were extracted because the only recovered content was resolver metadata, citation snippets, and an abstract-only ScienceDirect listing. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting open problems from these materials.
The run failed the source adequacy gate with failure mode paywalled_or_restricted and metadata_only: no readable exact-work full text was available within the bounded recovery pass.
Saved the exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/5502622.json and outputs/latest.json.
